limitations: The exact target installation already existed on HD1.1; this run validated staging, checksum verification, configuration copy, activation and postchecks, not a fresh software installation.
The active member job stopped at preflight, so poller-driven failover and second-member activation were not exercised.
Traffic measurement uses repeated HTTP health requests. It does not validate long-lived connection preservation or WAF attack-blocking behavior.

jobs.message: Step 8/8 · Health validation · 2947s elapsed: Target installed and baseline restored
Step 1/8 · Prechecks · 23s elapsed: configuration sync is 'Changes Pending'; sync the device group before upgrading

observations.detail: Job 32 staged and verified the ISO, backed up UCS, reused the exact target installation on HD1.1, copied configuration, rebooted, and passed two clean comparisons with 20/20 WAF policies and ASM ready.

REST IcrWorker initialization logged ICRD Busy / Operation timedout. Repeated authentication HTTP503 prevented reconnect. restjavad was manually restarted once at 2026-10-15T21:11:31Z. The result is assisted, not an unattended pass.
Job 33 was automatically claimed after job 32 completed, then blocked before failover/install/reboot because configuration sync was Changes Pending.
The sync precheck blocked the second job before it could perform failover. No automated pair failover or active-member upgrade was validated.

interventions.reason: REST IcrWorker initialization failed with ICRD Busy Operation timedout; repeated HTTP503 prevented reconnect

recovery_plan: Return non-serving lab02 to its preserved original HD1.2 volume; verify same release, WAF, roles and synchronization.
engineering_follow_up: Add explicit pair context and validate the upgraded peer before permitting the expected mixed-version sync state; do not blanket-ignore sync failures.
Verify traffic-group ownership and peer readiness after failover.
Validate both members and final config sync after the second upgrade.
Define bounded REST startup failure diagnostics and an explicit recovery policy.
Determine standby-first ordering from current roles or validate configured ordering immediately before starting.

implementation_findings.pair_discovery: Current workflow detects peers but does not automatically create or order both member jobs. The test configured explicit standby-first dependencies.
implementation_findings.sync_gate: f5_workflow.py preflight blocks all peer sync states except None, In Sync, or Standalone. Postchecks allow Changes Pending as a warning, creating a mismatch between the first job completion and second job admission.

recovery.action: Returned lab02 to preserved original HD1.2; normal configuration sync from lab02 to lab-ha and datasync-global-dg after both nodes were healthy on the same release.

traffic_observation.scope: Standby upgrade, manual REST recovery, standby rollback, and manual same-version failover/failback
